title: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
description_en: arXiv:2610.35942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I consider what it means for AI assistance to save time. I contrast a stopwatch view, on which time saved is whatever the clock records, with a ledger view, on which it is a counterfactual that has to be read next to the errors the work lets through, and I argue for the latter. The argument has four parts. I define a model-free pair of quantities, time saved and excess escaped defects, and one decision number built from them: the break-even defect cost. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

title: bytemail
description_en: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers. bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

title: SavorApp_AI
description_en: Capture what matters and move your intentions forward. Savor is an Intention Layer™ for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Speak, type, or snap a photo to create a clear card in Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring it back when it matters. Take Action (Beta) helps you explore options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. Review and adjust as you go. Hand off a card or a single step, with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next. Free on iOS and Android.

title: BotGauge
description_en: The trust layer for your agents . AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

title: Fraud Blocker
description_en: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

title: Notra

title: Tulu
description_en: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs. Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

title: Nuvio 5.0
description_en: Hand your financial admin to your AI agent. Automate invoicing, expenses and reconciliation. Ask Nuvio’s assistant to do the work, or connect ChatGPT, Claude or your own AI agent. We’re also adding bookkeeping and tax services with accountants who already know Nuvio.

title: PulseDev
description_en: Click any UI bug on localhost and your AI agent fixes it. Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Nothing is written until you do.

title: LFM3 by Liquid AI
description_en: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots. LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

title: NuPlay
description_en: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform. NuPlay runs AI agents for enterprises in production that improve after every run. Deploy agents for retail, customer service, consumer goods etc., across voice, chat, and email, connected to your existing systems. NuPlay is built as one platform, has 5 layers which build, run and improve the agents: NuPro, NuStack, NuContext, Nupulse and NuLoop.

title: Revix AI
description_en: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules. Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

title: Revix AI
description_en: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules. Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

title: Off Grid AI
description_en: Private AI on your phone and computer. . Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: GPT-6.1 Terra
description_en: Fast, capable computer use at half the price. GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's fast, efficient model for visual reasoning, precise computer use and natural writing. title: OpenRadView
description_en: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays. OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

title: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
description_en: Abliterated open models for security work. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

title: Genie 4
description_en: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer. Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

title: Hob

It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

title: App Store Screenshots
description_en: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots. A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. title: NINX
description_en: Private On-device AI, connected tools, & creative workflows. NINX is an AI workspace for getting things done using on-device models. Capture conversations in Notes, collaborate in Rooms, and take your workflows mobile with Ningenie.

title: Coachare
description_en: Your potential. Unlocked.. Coachare is an AI-powered coaching platform that helps managers and leaders grow. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML. Free, MIT, TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, plus an SDK for custom tools. Play with the live demo first.

title: Open For sales
description_en: Your next sales campaign is one prompt away. Open for Sales turns one prompt into a full sales campaign. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores fit, writes an editable sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp, then builds a live dashboard to track it. It's the outbound side of Open, the customer communications engine already running AI support across voice, chat, email and more. One engine now answers the customers you have and reaches the ones you want next.

title: NotiKeep
description_en: Notification history for iPhone, on your device. NotiKeep saves the notifications you get on iPhone using the new iOS 27 Shortcuts automation. See messages that were deleted or edited, search everything by app and conversation, and get alerts for words that matter. On-device, no account.

title: Trellis
description_en: More than a terminal: a native macOS workspace for devs. Trellis is a native macOS terminal that's more than a terminal: windows, tabs and splits in a sidebar, saved SSH hosts, one-click project tasks, a command palette and scratchpad, plus a CLI and MCP server so scripts and AI agents can drive it. Free, MIT.

title: Yardlet
description_en: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use. Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. It starts Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others with their own CLI and sign-in, and gives them one sidebar, composer and set of approval cards. Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task started in Yardlet also opens in the Codex app. It writes nothing into the agents' configuration, so you can stop using it any time. Diffs, a pull request tab, connectors and a browser the agents drive come with it.

title: Our Silly Games
description_en: Skills to build games with Claude. Free multiplayer hosting.. Our Silly Games is a free home for browser games made with Claude Code or Codex. Install the plugin, say "make me a game about...", and publish. We build it, review it and host it, with multiplayer, leaderboards, saves and phone controllers built in.

title: Mudroom
description_en: Run coding agents in a VM, review changes like a PR. Mudroom runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents in a Linux sandbox on a copy of your project, behind a network allowlist. Review the diff like a PR and apply only what you want, with undo. Mac app, plus a CLI for Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

title: Boltbar
description_en: Spotlight-style AI chat for your Mac. Boltbar is a native macOS AI chat bar. Press ⌥ Space in any app to ask GPT or Claude, then get back to work. Agent mode hands Claude Code or Codex a project with Look/Ask/Edit/Full permissions. MIT, signed and notarized; brew or DMG. Optional €19 supporter license.

title: Zest
description_en: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore. Hold ⌥ Space in any project and a Liquid Glass ring opens at your cursor. Flick at a slice and let go: Claude Code, Codex or your terminal takes the task, in its own git worktree if you want. When it's served, view the diff, merge it or yeet it. Runs locally.

title: Free AI Visibility Report
description_en: Show clients what ChatGPT says about them	. Agencies won SEO deals with keyword data. AI search gave them nothing to show a client. Now it does. Enter any domain, pick ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode or AI Overviews and a country. In about 4 minutes you get an AI answer audit: what the engine says about the brand, which pages it trusts, and a ranked fix list. Add your logo and name, and the PDF and booking link are yours. Free, no account.

title: tensemem
description_en: Memory that knows what still holds.. TenseMem is durable agent memory with a deterministic resolver, enforced cardinality, freshness-aware reads, and lasting corrections — so your agent gets what still holds, not a pile of conflicting prefs.

title: Asonix
description_en: Get more users for your iOS apps. Asonix helps iOS app teams find keywords they can actually rank for, compare opportunities across 175 countries, and track rankings daily. See competitors' Apple Search Ads and Meta ads, monitor AI visibility, and connect to AI agents via MCP.

title: Pattern
description_en: Agentic content strategist for short-form creators. Pattern learns who you are as a creator and watches every post you make, then tells you what to post next. Fix drafts before you post, turn viral videos in your niche into ideas in your own voice, and get a fresh content plan every week.

title: LemMeBuyIt
description_en: The retail data layer for AI agents and resellers. LemMeBuyIt is the retail data layer for AI agents, resellers and developers: live prices, 12-month price history, cross-retailer compare, ASIN and Buy Box mapping, and clearance signals across 100+ U.S. retailers. Free MCP server, one-click sign-in.

title: Smart Blur
description_en: Blur sensitive data automatically when you share your screen. Hide sensitive data on any webpage before you share your screen or send a screenshot. Smart Blur blurs emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SSNs, API keys and more the moment a page loads, all on your device. No account, nothing uploaded. Pro: Share Shield turns blurring on automatically when you share from Meet, Teams or Zoom on the web. Local AI runs OpenAI's Privacy Filter model in your browser to catch names and addresses that patterns miss.

title: Elephant-Goldfish Model
description_en: Draft specs with AI. Review with fresh agents.. EGM helps you draft software specs with AI, then fresh subagents review them without the earlier conversation. Run a drift report to compare specs with code. Open source. Works with Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and ChatGPT.
